utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Mara, did you hear about the repair drive they're organizing next weekend? They're fixing up old bikes for the kids.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh yeah, I've been dealing with the repair drive—it actually broke down on us last week. Jules and Gus offered to help, so hopefully we can get it sorted for the kids' bikes.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I thought it was all set for Saturday! Glad to hear Jules and Gus are stepping in to help sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, the repair drive? Yeah, I heard something about that. Hope it works out.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, it's really coming together! I'm thinking of lending a hand myself — want to join me? Could be fun working on something together.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Ah, appreciate the offer, Jules, but I'm swamped with stuff this week. You go ahead though — let me know if you need any tools or anything.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Kira, I was just talking to Leo about the repair drive — still on for Saturday, right?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, are you sure? I've heard mixed things about when it's actually happening.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, that's what I thought, but now I'm second-guessing. Noah wasn't sure either.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Leo, do you happen to know when the repair drive starts next Saturday? I need to work around the kids' soccer games.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It starts at 9 AM. Should wrap up by 3, so plenty of time before games.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks Leo! That should work out perfectly.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Pia, are you planning to donate anything to the repair drive? I'm helping load up some stuff.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m not sure yet — I’m still waiting on tool counts from a few people. Can we hold off loading until I have a full list?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, Pia, no rush. I can wait until you have the full list before we start loading.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? I'm afraid I can't quite recall the exact date we settled on. Could you remind me again?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, it's this weekend for sure — I saw it on the community board. I'm bringing my old lawnmower.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: This weekend, right! I knew I had it somewhere. I'll dig out my screwdriver set for sure.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Eli, I heard we're short on nails and lumber. I can swing by the hardware store tomorrow morning to grab some.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds fine, Dane. Just make sure you're back before 1 PM so we can get everything sorted for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it, I'll be back by noon to be safe.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Need any tools for the repair drive? I've got a full set in my garage if you need to borrow anything.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, thanks Gus—I might take you up on that. I'm still figuring out when I can actually join, but I'll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Nell—just holler whenever you're ready. My garage is always open.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Noah, can you walk me through exactly what happened with the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, I thought Vik said it was this weekend, but now I'm not sure—did I miss a change?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I'm asking about the repair drive itself, not just the schedule. Can you tell me what happened when it stopped working?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Quinn, we're prepping for the repair drive and I'm tracking supplies—got any spare nails or lumber lying around?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, you bet! I've got a box of nails out in the shed—I can bring 'em by Saturday morning!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That'd be great, Quinn! We're really low on nails, so every box helps. I'll mark you down for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Opal, have you heard about the repair drive? I'm still trying to get the full picture.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I've been trying to pin down its location—I thought I saw it near the old oak tree this morning, but I'm not sure.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, the old oak tree? I hadn't heard it might be there. I was thinking it was at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Rosa, I might be able to help with that repair drive after the weekend, if you still need people.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, that's so kind of you to offer! Actually, the drive has been moved to this Sunday at the community center, so if you're free then, we'd really appreciate the help.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Ah, Sunday... I'm not sure I can make it then, with things being a bit tight at home.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I'm still waiting on three replies, Mara. Can we confirm the tool handoff is set for 1 PM?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, Gus offered his torque wrench and socket set, so we're all set for 1 PM.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good, that's a relief. But are we certain those three folks will be on time?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Vik, I've got a socket wrench set from Gus if that helps with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, perfect! The repair drive is definitely this weekend — I saw it on the community board. I'm bringing my old lawnmower.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good, I'll bring the wrench set and see if there's anything else I can contribute.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I get started, can you walk me through exactly what happened with the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure thing! The idea is to get a group together to fix up the old community center this Saturday — we need volunteers for painting, small repairs, and organizing supplies.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Wait—I think we're mixing things up. I was asking about the repair drive we used on the console last week, not the community center. Can you tell me what happened with that drive?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Bo, you know about that repair drive this weekend? They're going to fix up old bikes for the kids, rain or shine!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh yeah, the bike fix-up thing? Sounds great, hope the weather holds up!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, the weather forecast looks good so far. Are you planning to volunteer? They could use all the hands they can get.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did I hear you mention a torque wrench? Just checking if that's still available for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely, my torque wrench is ready and waiting. I can bring it over whenever you need it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks. Do you know when we're actually starting the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, Opal, I'm so glad you asked! The repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, thank you Rosa! I was so confused about where it was. Sunday at the community center, got it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, I wanted to be sure everyone knew about the change. Will you be able to make it on Sunday?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I just wanted to check — are we still on for the repair drive later this week?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hmm, I thought Vik mentioned it being this weekend... or was that next? I'm a bit fuzzy on the details.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I thought it was after the weekend, but I might be mixing things up.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Ira, you’re just the person I wanted to see! The repair drive’s this Saturday morning—rain or shine—and we need all hands on deck to fix up bikes for the kids. You in?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good, Quinn. I’ve been hearing about it—count me in for Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Awesome, Ira! I’ll text you the meetup spot later—we’re kicking off at eight sharp.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? I'm afraid I can't quite recall the exact date we settled on. Could you remind me again?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I think it's this Saturday, but let me check with the organizer to be sure.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, good—if you check with them, that would be great. I really should write these things down... like where I put my screwdriver!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I'm glad you're interested, Faye! We haven't set a firm date yet, but once we gather enough parts and tools, we'll announce the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, got it! Well, keep me posted—I've got soccer games to juggle, but I can fit in some time to help out once you have the details.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I'll let you know as soon as we have a date! And if you have any spare electronics or parts lying around, donations are welcome too.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Hmm, I get that, but has anyone actually seen a flyer or an email about it? I just don't want to show up and find out it's been canceled.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I saw a post on the community board this morning. It's still on for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Alright, if you saw it on the board, I guess it's official. I'll mark my calendar.
